facts.fact_text: On 5 May 2018 people assembled into a non-approved rally in Cheboksary.
The non-approved rally on 5 May 2018 was held in a different manner as compared to the notice lodged by Ms P.
The Cheboksary town administration informed Ms P. that the itinerary for the march included areas where public events were not allowed under the regional legislation.
The Cheboksary town administration invited Ms P. to hold a meeting instead of the planned march and meeting event.
The Cheboksary town administration invited Ms P. to hold the meeting in one of the specially designated areas approved by the regional government in its Decree no. 598 of 26 December 2012.

Under the Federal Law no. 54-FZ of 19 June 2004 (the Public Events Act), the procedure for notification of a public event is determined by a regional statute.

Under the Chuvashiya Republic's Statute no. 77 of 30 November 2012, public events were prohibited at all locations mentioned in section 8 of the Federal Law no. 54-FZ of 19 June 2004 (the Public Events Act).
Under the Chuvashiya Republic's Statute no. 77 of 30 November 2012, public events were prohibited at buildings hosting municipal and public authorities and, until 2020, within thirty metres of them.
